# `set_search_region`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Set the guider star search region size.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x73010 (64-bit build) (store @0x730dc) |

Params is a scalar integer or one-element array holding it. The value is stored directly in the guide object (search region); there is no range check, and the unit is pixels by inference from its use in star search (INFERRED). The accepted path does not guard against an absent guide object.

Side effects: Writes the guider SearchRegion field (an operational star-search setting). When reached through an imager relay on the main table the same request can additionally trigger the reconnect callback described in the guider service notes (relay eligibility is a separate outer gate).

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_search_region"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | none (required) | A single integer, or an array whose first element is the integer. No range check in the handler; the unit is pixels (inferred from the star-search role). [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 104 | params is not an integer (or one-element array of integer) | `expected int param` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |

Behaviour with an absent guide object (possible crash) and downstream search limits are unresolved.

## Example

Request, request - Array form (shape READ; value invented):

```json

```

Reply, ok:


Reply, not-integer:

